record.title: Pakistan closes Afghan crossings after militant attacks
record.exceptions: Temporary Afghan return movement at Torkham and Chaman on 7–8 March; trade remained restricted during that window.
record.enforcement: Reopening order March 20; local customs account records trucks and pedestrians crossing March 21.
record.consequences: Travellers and freight were stranded; no aggregate loss estimate independently validated.
record.status_observation: actual reopening dated 2017-03-21; no inference of present status
record.official_rationale: Pakistan attributed attacks to Afghan-based militants; Afghanistan denied sheltering them.
record.context: Pakistan attributed attacks to Afghan-based militants; Afghanistan denied sheltering them.
record.uncertainty: 21 March actual reopening verified for Torkham; nationwide order was 20 March. Chaman implementation day not separately established. Temporary foot-return openings interrupted the broader restriction; not an uninterrupted total closure. Torkham reopening report still excluded Afghan students and restricted handcarts.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
